Requesting an accommodation under the ADA

All requests for accommodations under processed in accordance with Idaho Court Administrative Rule 50. If you have a request for accommodations in Ada, Boise, Elmore or Valley Counties please email [email protected]

Court Interpreters

If you need a court interpreter in Ada, Boise, Elmore, or Valley Counties, please email the Interpreter Office at [email protected]

Record Requests

All record requests are processed in accordance with Idaho Court Administrative Rule 32. If you would like to access a record that is not part of case file in Ada, Boise, Elmore or Valley Counties, please submit your request to [email protected]
